summary: A non-string gpu_noctx_advised_phases state value raises from the every-tick poll path.
Any whole-plan cuda-context line, including no/example/other-phase text, vacuously satisfies c73.
The new no-context fields are dropped by base PollResult, RunPod rewrap, and backend_poll serialization.
Partial-empty GPU memory CSV rows are accepted and can falsely claim every GPU is near zero.
A future persisted span anchor suppresses the advisory until wall time catches up.
